verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says you can "run your application closer to where your users are," which suggests some first-party control over deployment location. Nothing explicitly documents choosing a region for stored data (databases, volumes) or any data-residency guarantee. missing for 10: explicit region-selection docs for databases/volumes, list of available regions, data-residency/compliance guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.
